summary: South kerb of Iona Terrace backing onto bushland, homes only across the road.
reasons: Dense bush reserve on the van side
Homes across the road, 20 m or more
Dirt verge fits a van beside the lane

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the south side; nearest mapped dwellings are across the road, 20 to 25 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: A bare dirt verge runs along the south kerb, with a car parked on it, so a van can pull fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, with cars parked on the north side too.
drivers.convention: Cars park on both sides of the street, and one car stands on the south verge, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Steep: about 3.2% fall along the section, 7% max in places
Homes face the section across the road, 17 to 25 m away
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the south side; the afternoon sun comes from the west along the open street.
cannot_judge: Whether residents object to parked vans

best_section.where: South kerb of Iona Terrace, beside the bush reserve, near the parked car
